thread:
nate_sales: Help — NewCo POC is blocked. Calls to POST /v1/generate return 403 from their containerized client. Demo in ~3h, can someone triage?

ana_platform: Can you paste the curl they used and the full response body? 403 usually project binding or scope.

nate_sales: They sent this from a container: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_NEW' \
  -H 'X-Org-ID: newco-org' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwx-7b","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: `{"error":{"code":403,"message":"Forbidden: token project mismatch"}}`

rupert_support: That message implies the token is not authorized for the project endpoint they hit. Ask them to decode the token claims (base64 middle JWT segment) and paste `project` and `scopes`. Also confirm if they should be calling org endpoints or project endpoints — org-scoped keys behave differently.

nate_sales: They pasted decoded claims: `{"sub":"svc:newco-svc","project":"legacy-project","scopes":["embeddings:read","metrics:write"]}`

rupert_support: Ok: token has `legacy-project` but their request used a project route for a different project (they sent X-Org-ID only). Two issues: 1) token lacks `inference:invoke` scope; 2) they're using an org header where the request expects a project binding. For a project-scoped call they either need a token with the right `project` claim or to include `X-Project-ID` matching the token.

ana_platform: I'll issue a temp service key bound to `modern-project` (the project NewCo intended) with scopes `["inference:invoke","embeddings:read"]` and post a secure delivery.

zoe_security: Short security note for NewCo: if we reissue keys we can deliver wrapped in their KMS or provide short-lived ephemeral creds. Also include our audit-log retention (90 days) in the security questionnaire answer.

rupert_support: Created temp key `service_key_newco_77` (scopes: inference:invoke,embeddings:read) bound to project=modern-project, expires 7d. Ticket: POC-9008.

infra_bot: [bot] service_key_newco_77 delivered via secure-link by ana_platform. AuditID: AUD-8821.

nate_sales: They tried the new key plus `X-Project-ID: modern-project` but reported 401; error header: `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error=\"invalid_token\", error_description=\"signature verification failed\"`. They say they set the env var inside a Windows container via PowerShell.

rupert_support: Signature failures often mean the token has stray characters (CR/LF) or extra quotes. On Windows PowerShell `setx REDWOOD_KEY \"sk_live...\"` can insert quotes or a trailing CR. Ask them to run: `echo -n $env:REDWOOD_KEY | wc -c` (or print length) and compare to the length we provided. Recommend `setx REDWOOD_KEY sk_live_...` (no surrounding quotes) or use the Docker `--env` flag.

nate_sales: They removed the quotes/trailing CR and retried  200 OK. Streaming works and demo is back on.

rupert_support: Root cause summary: token/project binding mismatch (org header used instead of project header) + missing `inference:invoke` scope; secondary friction: token copied with Windows CRLF/quotes causing signature verification error. Logged remediation to POC-9008. :white_check_mark:
